speaker: Dr. Goldfine
content: Bree, Rex just called. He won't be able to meet you here today, apparently, there was an emergency at the hospital.
mark: be able to 能够、有能力做某事
emergency n. 突发事件，紧急情况；急诊病人 emerge一件事情突然冒出来、意外浮现出来 → 突发意外事件 → 紧急突发事件。

speaker: Bree
content: Oh, Well, I wish he'd called me.
mark: wish + had done，对过去事情的虚拟，过去没做。对将来（期盼未来）：wish + would do。 对现在正在进行：wish + were/was doing

speaker: Dr. Goldfine
content: He suggested perhaps you'd like to meet with me by yourself? You've been very quiet in our joint sessions.
mark: perhaps adv. 可能；也许 maybe
would like to 想要或希望做某事
meet sb 普通见面 vs meet with sb 有目的正式会面
by yourself 独自，自己 on your own
joint adj. 联合的，共同的，共有的；连带的
session. （某项活动的）一段时间，一场；会议，开庭；学年，上课时间；in session 会议进行中：正在进行正式会议的过程。

speaker: Bree
content: What? No, thank you. I have some things that I need to do today.

speaker: Bree
content: Dr. Goldfine, there is something you can do for me.
